pkgmetadata.longdescription: rocprofiler-register is the small brokering library that ROCm runtimes (HIP, HSA, rocDecode and friends) link against so that a profiler can attach to them at runtime. The runtimes call into it at load time; the profiler registers itself with it. It carries no profiling logic of its own and exists to decouple the runtimes from any particular profiler implementation.
